newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks push higher at open, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks push higher at open, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: Wall Street climbed sharply higher at the opening on Wednesday, extending exuberant gains after Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's upbeat Humphrey-Hawkins testimony on the economy yesterday.
The Dow Jones Industrial average quickly moved ahead 71 points, or 0.88 percent, to 8132. The New York Stock Exchange set index-arbitrage trading curbs nine minutes after the open.
